reasoning: The question asks if North Atlantic daily SST will reach a record high between Feb 1 and May 1, 2026. Evidence shows 2025 was exceptionally warm globally (3rd warmest SST year), with North Atlantic anomalies up to 1.5°C above average. However, the background states 2026 started with lower temperatures than 2025. January 2026 saw the North Atlantic record 'highest sea surface temperatures ever documented for this time of year,' but this is a seasonal record, not an all-time daily record. The evidence indicates strong warming trends and marine heatwaves, but no indication that daily records are imminent in Feb-May 2026. Given that 2025 was warmer than 2026 so far, and the question requires beating the highest daily value from any previous year on that calendar day, the probability is moderate but not high.
